# @gernst/bootstrap (v4-modern)

> Maintained fork of Bootstrap 4.6.2, modernized for 2026-era stacks. Drop-in replacement for
> `bootstrap@4`: byte-identical CSS, unchanged jQuery plugin API (`$.fn.*`) and `data-*`
> attributes, but compatible with Dart Sass 2/3, jQuery 3.5+/4 and Popper 2 (@popperjs/core).
> Verified against AdminLTE 3.

## Install

- `bootstrap` → `npm:@gernst/bootstrap@^4.7.0` (npm alias keeps every `import "bootstrap"` /
  `@import "bootstrap"` / webpack `~bootstrap` working unchanged)

## Key facts

- JavaScript: jQuery plugins, jQuery >=3.5 <5 accepted; Popper v1 options are auto-translated
  to Popper 2; `bootstrap.bundle` embeds Popper.
- Sass: two trees shipped — `scss/` (legacy `@import`, zero-effort swap) and `scss/module/`
  (`@use`/`@forward`, recommended, identical CSS output).
- Module tree: namespaced members (`variables.$primary`, `functions.tint-color()`,
  `mixins.media-breakpoint-up()`, `rfs.rfs()`); configure via `@use "variables" with (...)`.
- Functions that read variables (`color`, `theme-color`, `color-yiq`, `gray`,
  `theme-color-level`, `escape-svg`) live in the `variables` module.
- No variable overrides before `@import` in module semantics — use `with()` instead.
- Version 4 only; for Bootstrap 5 see the `v5-modern` branch.
